001.name: Avery Obtainia
001.subtype: Angelor / Water Spirit / Mystical Legends / Deity Contract

additional.text: Summon Requirement Place 1 of your Characters with 8 or more Power in your discard pile.
On Summon Restore 2 HP. Then choose 1 allied Character. It gains +3 [Light] damage until the end of the turn.
Divine Catalyst: If Avery Obtainia has 10 or more Power, reduce all damage dealt to him by 1.
“Even the smallest light can become a beacon of hope.”
